name: manual_f3f279
claim: gbrain per-source sync must run from INSIDE that source's own git repo (its local_path). Use 'gbrain sync --repo <path> --source <id>' from a non-git cwd or neutral directory. A bare 'gbrain sync' from non-git cwd fails.

decisions.notes: Mined from PT docs/LESSONS.md 2026-05-27 and orama 2026-06-22: bare sync from non-git cwd triggers 'Not a git repository'. Autopilot launchd KeepAlive=true needs 'launchctl unload -w' — kill won't stick.

rationale: Mined from PT docs/LESSONS.md 2026-05-27 and orama 2026-06-22: bare sync from non-git cwd triggers 'Not a git repository'. Autopilot launchd KeepAlive=true needs 'launchctl unload -w' — kill won't stick.
